Comment.Language: For the Feast of the Nativity:

Text.Language: Pjinmici m~paryenikon: ouoh ninakhi m~p~neumatikon: ous~v/ri m~paradoxon: kata nic~m/ m~p~rov/tikon.
The virginal birth, and the spiritual emissions, are an amazing wonder, according to the prophets.
ميلاد بتولى وطلق روحى عجيب ممجد حسب الأخبار النبوية.
